shared_elements: round-topped (arched) framing outline enclosing the whole composition
incised linear framing lines following the arch
a scene in the upper register within the arch
justification: The only real correspondence is the arched, round-topped frame with concentric incised border lines enclosing a single figural field, a broadly shared stele convention rather than a specific motif. Otherwise the content is wholly different: A shows a crowded lunette of human figures flanking columns of script with rayed disc above and many dense lines of writing below, while B shows only a bare, schematic outline drawing of a masted boat over stylised waves with no figures or script.
